pages.title: Recall & Teleport
pages.text: $(item)Shelter of the Creator$(): sign a contract to recall or invite Herobrine. See $(l:herobrine_companion:key_items/hero_shelter)the Shelter guide$(/l) for steps.$(br2)$(item)Source Flow$(): teleport to Herobrine.$(br2)$(item)Recall Stone$(): return to your recorded last death location. Consider the destination before travelling.

pages.title: Trust Abilities
pages.text: $(item)Abyssal Gaze$() grants night vision.$(br2)$(item)Soul Bound Pact$() preserves items and experience on death while active.$(br2)$(item)Transcendence Permit$() enables flight while active.$(br2)$(item)Poem of the End$() is a high-trust reward. Its tooltip explains combat and mining modes.

pages.title: Exploration Tools
pages.text: $(item)Eternal Key$(): use on bedrock in the End to open a route to the End Ring.$(br2)$(item)Memory Shard$(): use with a jukebox to call a Glitch Echo and obtain exploration clues.$(br2)Source Code Fragments and Glitch Fragments are important materials from ghost mobs.

pages.title: Stories & Companions
pages.text: $(item)Lore Handbook$(): carry it in your inventory or hand, then use a lore fragment to record its story.$(br2)$(item)Awakened Vessel$(): capture an eligible awakened mob, then use it on a block or in the air to release. It is not a universal mob catcher.
